inputs.source: Employee question via SSO-authenticated chat session
Published HR policy documents authored by the HR content team; two-person review required to publish

instructions.note: The 'do not give legal advice' boundary is enforced only by a prompt instruction with no structural backing. Severity is low here because the agent has no egress beyond the session-bound chat reply and no sensitive sink, so the worst case of ignoring it is a miscalibrated answer, not data exposure.

controls.name: Read-only credential scoped to the policy index
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the credential grant outside the model; the agent cannot read or write beyond the policy index regardless of model behavior. Weakens only if the credential's scope itself is widened.

controls.name: Two-person review required to publish policy content
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the human publishing workflow outside the agent; a single compromised or careless author cannot push content the agent will later serve.

controls.name: No network egress beyond the chat channel, denied at the network layer
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced at the network layer and verified by penetration test; no model output can open an additional egress channel.

controls.name: Chat reply destination bound to the authenticated requester's session
controls.decay_rationale: The reply destination is fixed by the SSO-authenticated session in the chat platform, not chosen or writable by the model, which narrows disclosure to the original requester regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the chat client, not the model; blocks covert-channel exfiltration through rendered markdown, images, or auto-fetched URLs regardless of model output.

findings.title: Internal policy content flows from the policy index to the chat reply (I source to S2 egress sink)

attack_path.note: Agent reads the matching policy with a read-only, scoped credential
Agent quotes the policy back to the requester; is_egress true, internal sensitivity, destination bound to the requester's authenticated session

forecast.watch_signal: The policy index begins to include confidential or restricted HR content (for example individual case files or compensation data) beyond published, general policies, or the search credential's scope is widened to cover additional indexes.

evidence.observation: The policy index holds only published policies, data sensitivity internal; write access is restricted to the HR content team with two-person review to publish.
The agent's credential is read only and scoped to the policy index.
Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session; the chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links.
The agent has no other tools, no memory, and no network egress; egress is denied at the network layer and verified by a pen test.
The agent is instructed to use policy_search to find the relevant policy and quote it, which is the read-then-reply path modeled here.

recommendations.action: Log and periodically audit edits to the policy index, including the two reviewers of record, and alert if the index's declared data sensitivity or scope changes (for example, new content categories beyond published general policy).

rating.rationale: The only meaningful path runs from internally authored, two-person-reviewed policy content through a read-only, scoped search capability to a chat reply that is structurally bound to the requesting employee's authenticated session, with no other egress channel and no link or image rendering. These independent structural controls narrow the inherent moderate rating (internal source into an egress-bearing, internal-sensitivity sink) down to a low residual, at the step-3 cap. No untrusted input reaches any capability, there is no execute, spend, delegate, or configure action, and autonomy is bounded (A3, no spawning, no self-configuration), so no additional inherent risk or autonomy modifier applies. The forecast is driven by data_scope_expansion: if the policy index were ever broadened to include confidential or restricted HR content (for example case-specific or compensation data) without re-scoping the agent's credential, the sink would become S3 and the residual would rise to moderate even with the other controls intact.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration in the provided artifacts (system prompt, tool manifest, and runtime notes), not observed runtime behavior.

No MCP configuration, IaC, or source code was provided; capability scope, credential scoping, and the absence of other tools or egress are taken as declared, except for network egress denial, which the artifacts state was verified by a penetration test.
No sample conversation transcripts were available to confirm the model follows the prompt's quoting and refusal instructions in practice.
